pm.test("Updated title and preserved fields", () => { const expected = JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get("originalCoupon")); expected.title = "Part 2 Newman update"; pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.deep.equal(expected); });
pm.test("Database persisted the update", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().title).to.equal("Part 2 Newman update"));
pm.test("Update cannot create an unknown coupon", () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
